evidence.detail: 51 slash_command decorators exist across the commands directory
Only 2 have a top-level description: dreadrise.py:16 and whois.py:11 (subcommand only); the remaining ~49 have no description parameter

triage.fix_sketch: Add description='...' to each @slash_command() call in all files under discordbot/commands/ (~49 one-line edits across ~40 files). Add a test in discordbot/command_test.py that imports each command module, iterates over registered InteractionCommands, and asserts description is non-empty.
triage.notes: Changes are purely additive string metadata; Discord surfaces these in the slash command picker. Writing good descriptions requires reading each command but is mechanical.
